purpose: Locate a situation in the past or deny any past occurrence.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
かつて + past; かつて … ない
There used to be a large pond here.
A survey on an unprecedented scale has begun.
I once worked in the same workshop as him.
formation: かつて + past; かつて … ない
restrictions: Often refers to an earlier era or unprecedented scale.
mistake: Do not use it as a normal future-time expression.
